# Genesis Apocryphon Column 17 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**17:1** [...] the generations [...] and Shem fathered [...] Arpachshad [...]

**17:2** [...] and Arpachshad fathered [...] Shelah [...] and Shelah fathered Eber [...]

**17:3** [...] and Eber fathered [...] Peleg [...] for in his days the earth was divided [...]

**17:4** [...] Reu [...] Serug [...] Nahor [...]

**17:5** [...] and Nahor fathered Terah [...] in the land of Ur [...]

**17:6** [...] and Terah fathered Abram [...] and Nahor and Haran [...]

**17:7** [...] Abram took Sarai [...] as his wife [...]

**17:8** [...] and Haran died [...] in Ur of the Chaldeans [...] before Terah his father [...]

**17:9** [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 17 is nearly destroyed. The fragments trace the genealogy from Shem to Abraham, following the line of Genesis 11:10-32 but in Aramaic retelling. "Fathered" is used consistently for the genealogical verb. "Ur of the Chaldeans" follows the standard English form of this geographical designation.*
